tool_args.rationale: Fit all four parameters numerically using the archived Hill-2 inhibition law, then test it on fresh confirmation data. The broad sink-gradient span provides leverage on inhibition without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot spans sink gradients 0.25 to 2.25, so the archive's narrow-gradient trigger does not apply; the cooperative Hill signature and five observations support a first confirmation.
The cooperative Hill model directly matches the observed sigmoidal onset and competitive sink-inhibition signature; retain the barrier model as an alternative if confirmation fails.
The evidence does not indicate a coupled memory ODE, and the pilot already covers the target horizon.
